title: Computations in Equivariant Topological Hochschild Homology
summary: One of the most effective approaches to computations in algebraic $K$-theory is trace methods, which compare algebraic $K$-theory with topological Hochschild homology and topological cyclic homology. In recent work, two of the authors, together with Gerhardt, construct an equivariant refinement of topological Hochschild homology ($\mathrm{ETHH}$) which receives a trace map from Merling's genuine equivariant algebraic $K$-theory.
